title: Naujawan ki Lash Pe
body:
Sunke Bete Ki Fugha Khaime Se Sarwar Nikle
Tham Ke Apni Qamar Sare Dilawar Nikle
khoon Me Dubey Hue Jibril Ke Par Nikle
Hath Ankhon Pe Rkhe Sare Payabemr Nikle
Ladkhada Te Phir Uth Te They Baith Jate Thy
De Ke Akbar Akbar Ko Sada Bain Kiye Jate They
Haye Mera Ali Akbar-2
Naujawan Ki Lash Pe Kehte They Ye Rokar Hussain-2
Agaya Baba Tera Uth Ja Aye Mere Dil Chain
Naujawan....
1) Bas Abhi Abbas Ke Jane Se Tuti Hai Kamar
To Sare Maqtal Gaya Jabse Nhi Ata Nazar
Noor Ankhon Ka Gaya Jane Se Tere Nor E Ayen
Naujawan....
2) Baith Jate Hai Kabhi Shabbir Bete Ke Qrib
Aur Sada Dete They Nana Ho gaya main gharib
Lut gai meri Kamai Ya Shahe Badro Hunain
Naujawan....
3) Ab Utho Tazim Ko Dadai Bulane Agai
Tham Kar Apni Qamar Dekho Sirhane Agai
Sun Rahe Ho Aye Mere Beta Meri Amma Ke Bain
Naujawan......
4) Dasht Ki Garmi Ne Gehra Hai Ghazab Ki Pyaas Hai
Naa Raha Qasim Madad Ko Naa Mera Abbas Hai
Ya Ali kijey Madad Lasha Uthaye Tab Hussain
Naujawan....
5) Padhke Jab Nade Ali Khenchi Kaleje Se Sina
Fass Ke Nayze Ki ani Me Qalb Bahar Agaya
Asama roya Zami Par Mach Gaya Ek Shoro Shain
Naujawan...
6) Likhte Likhte Maqtale Akbar Ruka Roashan Qalam
Jo Sitam Shabbir Par Tute Nhi hoge raqam
Hogaye hai khoon me tar mashrkain aur maghrabain
